players.product: Electrostatic chucks and AD (aerosol deposition) ceramic chamber components for semiconductor etching equipment

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 to March 2026) consolidated results: net sales JPY 737,441 million (+1.8% year on year), operating profit JPY 53,759 million (+10.9%), ordinary profit JPY 60,689 million (+20.5%) and profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 40,257 million (+230.8%), the latter after extraordinary items including restructuring costs in the China mainland business and gains on sales of investment securities. Management states that during the year global AI-related demand expanded rapidly, while uncertainty from US tariff policy and other factors, stagnant housing markets in major regions and inflation made world economic growth somewhat slower.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 737,441 million (+1.8%); operating profit JPY 53,759 million (+10.9%); ordinary profit JPY 60,689 million (+20.5%); net profit JPY 40,257 million (+230.8%)

quarterly_data.signal: New Business Domains (Ceramics business) FY2026: net sales JPY 67,414 million (+34.0%) and operating profit JPY 28,943 million (+41.7%); segment production (at selling prices) JPY 53,029 million (+48.2%). Management states replacement demand stayed firm as semiconductor device makers raised utilization at their existing fabs, lifting sales of TOTO ceramic products adopted in semiconductor manufacturing equipment; with the semiconductor market expected to keep growing on global AI demand, TOTO is focusing on deepening and strengthening development of fine ceramics technology centered on electrostatic chucks, and on further advancing its smart factory (automated, optimized high-efficiency production) to respond quickly to demand swings and raise its presence in the semiconductor supply chain.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 67,414 million (+34.0%); operating profit JPY 28,943 million (+41.7%); production JPY 53,029 million (+48.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: Management policy for the Ceramics business: strengthen technology development for increasingly advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment and raise productivity to supply the growing semiconductor market; propose the value of 'only-one' products for next-generation semiconductor manufacturing equipment and semiconductor lithography (exposure) equipment and seek adoption in new applications; and, in production, further evolve the smart factory through DX, AI analysis and data linkage across the whole value chain from suppliers to customers, building a high-efficiency system capable of on-demand production.

R&D: group R&D expenses in FY2026 were JPY 26,296 million, of which the Ceramics business JPY 2,123 million. The Ceramics business develops high-quality, high-precision ceramic products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, such as electrostatic chucks and engineering ceramics, in collaboration with semiconductor equipment makers and suppliers; at a major fine-ceramics trade show it showed, as reference exhibits, engineering ceramics 'ultra-large, high specific-rigidity ceramic components' and 'air slide', together with 'SiSiC ceramics', which the company says achieve an extremely dense and smooth surface through its proprietary microstructure control technology.
quarterly_data.figure: Group R&D JPY 26,296 million; Ceramics business R&D JPY 2,123 million

quarterly_data.signal: Capex: FY2026 capital expenditure JPY 43,159 million (including intangible assets), of which New Business Domains JPY 4,966 million for installing and renewing production equipment. Planned group investment for the fiscal year ending March 2027 (the company's 'fiscal 2026') is JPY 52,700 million: Ceramics business JPY 7,600 million (production equipment-related), Japan Housing Equipment JPY 23,000 million, Overseas Housing Equipment JPY 12,800 million (including Americas JPY 7,100 million) and Other JPY 9,300 million (head office reorganization and others).
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex JPY 43,159 million (New Business Domains JPY 4,966 million); planned investment JPY 52,700 million (Ceramics JPY 7,600 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Global Housing Equipment FY2026: net sales JPY 669,742 million (-0.6%) and operating profit JPY 27,921 million (-9.7%). Japan Housing net sales JPY 479,663 million (-0.3%), operating profit JPY 20,253 million (-7.5%); Americas JPY 75,623 million (+7.3%), operating profit JPY 4,790 million (-7.0%); Asia-Oceania JPY 54,914 million (+9.3%), operating profit JPY 10,239 million (+24.3%); Europe JPY 5,677 million (+16.3%), operating loss JPY 428 million; China mainland JPY 53,863 million (-19.5%), operating loss JPY 6,934 million. Management states it closed two sanitary ware plants in China mainland, optimized staffing at other plants and is consolidating production into plants with the latest equipment, aiming for the China mainland business to return to profit in the fiscal year ending March 2027 (the company's 'fiscal 2026').
quarterly_data.figure: Global Housing net sales JPY 669,742 million (-0.6%), operating profit JPY 27,921 million (-9.7%); China mainland operating loss JPY 6,934 million

quarterly_data.signal: To strengthen supply in the Americas, TOTO began producing sanitary ware in November 2025 in a new plant building rebuilt on its existing factory site in Morrow, Georgia; with the latest equipment installed, production capacity expanded to 150% of the previous level.
